NEXT_STEP.HEALTHY: Keep routine monitoring and route any new complaint to the support desk without changing account permissions.

CREATE.DEPARTMENT_ROLE_HINT: Suggested from the selected role. You can change it if the staff sits in another unit.
CREATE.TEAM_ROLE_HINT: Teams are filtered by department. Changing the role updates the suggested team.
CREATE.SCOPE_GLOBAL: Global scope — no entity link required
CREATE.SCOPE_VENDOR: Link this account to an existing vendor company
CREATE.SCOPE_DRIVER: Select the driver, then set a temporary password and role for their existing login
CREATE.DRIVER_PROVISION_MODE: This grants access on the driver's existing account (same UserId as the driver profile). Profile fields below update that account.
CREATE.VENDOR_OWNER_PROVISION_MODE: The email matches the vendor owner. Access will be provisioned on the owner's existing account, not a new duplicate user.
CREATE.PROVISION_EMAIL_LOCKED: Email is tied to the existing account for this provision flow.
CREATE.SCOPE_CUSTOMER: Customer scope links to the created user automatically
CREATE.SCOPE_ENTITY_DRIVER_HINT: This does not create a new driver. Pick an existing driver from the drivers list — the login will be tied to that driver app profile.
CREATE.SCOPE_ENTITY_VENDOR_HINT: Pick an existing vendor on the platform. The login will be scoped to that vendor company or branch in the vendor panel.
CREATE.SCOPE_ENTITY_MANUAL_HINT: Use this when the list is empty or you already know the entity ID.
CREATE.NO_ENTITIES_VENDOR: No vendors loaded. Enter a vendor ID manually or open the vendors page first.
CREATE.NO_ENTITIES_DRIVER: No drivers loaded. Enter a driver ID manually or open the drivers page first.
CREATE.ENTITY_REQUIRED: Vendor and driver accounts must be linked to an existing entity.
CREATE.VALIDATION_REQUIRED: Complete all required fields before creating the account.
CREATE.FAILED: Could not create the account. Review the role and scope, then try again.
